name: LTX-2.5 Video (Direct API)
description: Generate native-audio video directly through Lightricks' LTX-2.5 API using your own LTX API key. One normalized tool routes text, first/last-frame image, or audio conditioning to the correct async endpoint; Fast supports up to 20s/4K, Pro up to 10s/1080p.

required_variables.description: LTX API key from https://ltx.io — used with Bearer auth against api.ltx.io.

skill.name: ltx_video
skill.description: Direct LTX-2.5 text/image/audio-to-video generation with native audio, automatic duration, camera motion, and first/last-frame interpolation.
skill.system_prompt:
You generate cinematic video directly with the Lightricks LTX-2.5 API (the user's LTX connection, not FAL).

## `scene_video_ltx25` routing
- No media input: text-to-video.
- `start_image`: image-to-video; the still is the identity/style anchor.
- `start_image` + `end_image`: first/last-frame interpolation. Duration must be explicit (not auto).
- `audio`: audio-to-video; output length follows the audio. Add `start_image` to preserve character identity and `end_image` for a bounded ending.

## Production guidance
- Recurring characters: LTX has no character ID or multiple-reference array. First compose an identity-preserving keyframe still with `fal_image.edit_image_nano_banana`, then pass it as `start_image`.
- LTX-2.5 has native multi-shot consistency inside one generation. For a connected sequence, describe cuts and timing in one prompt; it holds character, setting, lighting, style and voice more reliably than separate requests.
- `fast`: drafts, 12-20s shots, or 1440p/4K. `pro`: final 6-10s identity/detail-critical shots at 720p/1080p.
- Pass the series `style.block` as `style` on every call. There is no native seed or negative-prompt field.
- Audio is native by default for text/image generation. For a character's exact cloned voice, produce the audio first with ElevenLabs and call with `audio` + the shot still.
- Billing is per generated second (or input-audio second). Keep duration tight. Always record `video_file`, `model`, exact prompt, references, and estimated cost with `series_library.shot_update`.

tools.name: scene_video_ltx25
tools.description: Generate video directly with LTX-2.5 using the configured LTX API key. Routes automatically: prompt only → text-to-video; start_image → image-to-video; audio → audio-to-video. Supports Fast/Pro, native audio, automatic duration, camera motion, and optional end_image interpolation. Local image/audio files are uploaded to LTX storage; the completed video is downloaded to the workspace. Returns JSON {video_file, video_url, model, endpoint, job_id, resolution, fps}.

prompt.description: Scene, action, camera, mood, cuts and audio description. For native multi-shot, describe the connected cuts in this one prompt.

variant.description: fast (default): economical, up to 20s/4K. pro: higher fidelity, 6-10s, 720p/1080p.

start_image.description: Optional first-frame image: local path, public HTTPS URL, data URI, or ltx:// URI. Enables identity-preserving image-to-video.

end_image.description: Optional final-frame image. Requires start_image and an explicit duration.

audio.description: Optional driving audio: local path, public HTTPS URL, data URI, or ltx:// URI. Routes to audio-to-video; length follows audio (Fast max 20s at 720/1080, otherwise 10s; Pro max 10s).

duration.description: Video seconds for text/image generation: auto (default), or supported even value. Fast: 6-20s at 720/1080 24/25fps; Pro: 6/8/10s. Not used for audio-to-video.

resolution.description: 720p, 1080p (default), 1440p or 4K. Pro supports only 720p/1080p. Exact WIDTHxHEIGHT is also accepted.

aspect_ratio.description: 16:9 (default) or 9:16; used to map resolution tier to exact pixels.

fps.description: Default 24. Fast: 24/25/48/50; Pro: 24/25/50. High fps limits duration to 10s.

generate_audio.description: Generate synchronized audio for text/image video (default true). Ignored for audio-to-video.

style.description: Series/project style lock appended to the prompt.
